repomix.user_provided_header: Brands & Products API Integration Bundle: Complete codebase bundle for connecting the designed Brands and Products screens to backend APIs. Covers Backoffice Catalog UI (CatalogMockPage, catalog-reference.jsx, catalog-reference.css), Brands CRUD, Products list with full filter pipeline (search, category, brand, channel, status, featured, sort), Product Form wizard with all four tabs (Basic, Variants, Media, Review & Publish readiness checklist), variant pricing and cost permissions, barcode generation, transactional media uploading and reordering, API client endpoints, Laravel admin & store catalog controllers, requests, models, resources, seeders, feature tests (ProductCatalogTest, ProductMediaCatalogTest, VariantCatalogTest, StorefrontCatalogTest), and design specifications (task.txt, dasign.txt, data.jsx, design.html, home.html, api.md, phase2-audit.md).
